name: Get Pro: checkout sheet
what: Get Pro opens getoffgridai.co/pro/app/ in a sheet over the app, in the app's theme, with the live price. 'Have a key? Enter it in the app' is the first line, above the fold.

name: Checkout sheet, dark
what: The same page when the app is dark (theme passed in the link, so it follows the app, not the phone).

name: After paying, in the sheet
what: /thank-you/ in the app's sheet shows only the confirmation and 'Paste your key in the app'. (Shot with a test session, so it says 'Check your payment'; a real payment says 'You're in.')

name: Back in the app: key field
what: 'Have a key? Enter it in the app' (offgrid://pro/unlock) closes the sheet and opens the license-key field in the app. The key is never typed on the web.
